takeover_max_minutes.null: 空值须由同卡 takeover_status 字段消歧 null must be disambiguated by the card's takeover_status field

interop.purpose_zh: 声明折返协议与相邻开放标准的对照关系、唯一互转轴与已知不对称,供同时采用两套标准的方案做机器校验。本块为附加层,不改变任何既有字段语义;不做互操作的读者可整块忽略。
interop.purpose_en: Declares how this protocol crosswalks to adjacent open standards, names the conversion axis, and registers known asymmetries, so packages adopting both can machine-check the pairing. Additive layer; no existing field semantics change.

crosswalk_axis.note_zh: 外部接口对照(Issue #1119, lqqk7, 2026-08-13)把互转轴称作 gate_id,并假定该字段位于本协议卡片层。更正:本协议卡片层没有 gate_id,而有两个不同字段——`gate` 是卡片当前所处的验证阶梯位置(virtual_evaluation / controlled_site / limited_real_street),承担等级排序,它才是互转轴;`ascent_grade`(G0-G3)是该卡**已经达成**的证据等级,与外部 gate_id 共用 G0-G3 值域但语义不同(达成 vs 绑定)。把 ascent_grade 直接当 gate_id 用,会允许一张只有 G0 纸面证据的卡片认领 L3 开放等级,即 R4「纸面证据不得冒充现场证据」在互操作层的同型违例。规则 R5 即为此而设。
crosswalk_axis.note_en: The external interface comparison (Issue #1119, lqqk7, 2026-08-13) named the conversion axis gate_id and assumed that field sits on this protocol's card layer. Correction: there is no gate_id on the card layer. There are two distinct fields. `gate` is the card's current position on the verification ladder (virtual_evaluation / controlled_site / limited_real_street) and carries level ordering — that is the conversion axis. `ascent_grade` (G0-G3) is the evidence grade the card has ALREADY ATTAINED; it shares the G0-G3 value space with the external gate_id but not its meaning (attainment vs binding). Equating ascent_grade with gate_id would let a card holding only G0 paper evidence claim open level L3 — the interop-layer twin of an R4 violation. Rule R5 exists to reject exactly that.

status_crosswalk.direction_zh: 单向可算:给定外部 (open_level_id, gate_id) 可唯一推出本协议三色;反向 yellow 至少覆盖 L1-L3,须补 `gate` 才能定位到具体一级。
status_crosswalk.direction_en: One-way computable: an external (open_level_id, gate_id) pair maps to exactly one colour here; in reverse, yellow spans L1-L3 and needs `gate` to disambiguate.

rows.note: adoption and normal operation; L3 and L4 bind the same grade and are separated by entry and stop conditions, not by gate number
switchback is a downgrade, not a level; corresponds to downgrade_allowed=true on the external side

known_asymmetries.zh: `expiry_date`(本协议留痕条目必填)在 SEB 侧无对应字段。两侧同用时须由采用方自行补齐,本协议不代为假定。
known_asymmetries.en: `expiry_date`, required on this protocol's ledger entries, has no counterpart on the SEB side. Adopters using both must supply it themselves; this protocol does not assume one.

known_asymmetries.zh: 本协议留痕登记的是**事件**(near_miss / switchback / decommission),SEB 变更回执登记的是**判据变更与被删样本**。二者是同一份档案的两列,不是两份档案,不得互相替代。
known_asymmetries.en: This protocol's ledger registers EVENTS (near_miss / switchback / decommission); SEB change receipts register CRITERION CHANGES and dropped samples. They are two columns of one archive, not two archives, and must not substitute for each other.

known_asymmetries.zh: L3 与 L4 绑定同一 G3,差别由准入与停止条件划出,不由闸门编号划出。因此 gate_id 单独不足以区分 L3/L4,须同时读 status。
known_asymmetries.en: L3 and L4 bind the same G3; they are separated by entry and stop conditions, not by gate number. gate_id alone cannot distinguish L3 from L4 — status must be read alongside it.

registered_baselines.name_zh: 服务等价基准 Service Equivalence Baseline
registered_baselines.publisher: lqqk7 / 万感京张 EVERY SENSE JING-ZHANG
registered_baselines.relation_note_zh: 不在同一层,可在同一张卡片上共存:本协议是运行期状态机,SEB 是开放等级阶梯与判据集,字段不重叠、语义不冲突。本条是**接口对照登记,不是采用登记**——本包未采用任何 SEB 字段,亦未认领任何 SEB 开放等级。
registered_baselines.relation_note_en: Not the same layer; the two can coexist on one card. This protocol is a run-time state machine; SEB is an open-level ladder and criteria set. Fields do not overlap and semantics do not conflict. This is an INTERFACE REGISTRATION, NOT AN ADOPTION — this package adopts no SEB field and claims no SEB open level.
registered_baselines.crosswalk_verified_against: the structured gate_binding of seb-spec as cited in the interface comparison of 2026-08-13; SEB has since advanced to v0.5.0 and this crosswalk has not been re-verified against the later revisions
registered_baselines.self_declaration: none — no card in this package declares an interop mapping; the crosswalk table and rule R5 are supplied for adopters who do

interop.boundary_zh: 对照与校验通过只证明两套标准之间的字段映射自洽,不证明任一方案的现场成效、批准或任何政府承诺,也不表示两套标准的发布方之间存在合作关系。
interop.boundary_en: A passing crosswalk validation certifies only that the field mapping between the two standards is self-consistent. It proves no field performance, approval or government commitment for either package, and implies no partnership between the two publishers.

belt_wide_defaults.non_smart_fallback: 15-minute-walk ordinary-equivalent service path; non-smartphone and accessible paths designed in parallel
belt_wide_defaults.ledger: Switchback Ledger entries published at quarterly Switchback Days as the counterpart of the honor wall
belt_wide_defaults.disclaimer_zh: 全部时限为设计目标值,非政府承诺;正式时限以运营协议为准。所有场景为概念建议,不表述为已批准运营。
belt_wide_defaults.disclaimer_en: All time limits are design targets, not government commitments; formal limits per operating agreements. All scenarios are conceptual suggestions, never described as approved operations.
belt_wide_defaults.switchback_trigger: one safety-grade event requiring human takeover, OR 90-day complaint/takeover-failure rate above threshold; thresholds set from Phase-1 measured baselines, then published (no fictitious pre-filled numbers)
belt_wide_defaults.recovery_condition: two consecutive clean review cycles + one yellow observation period before returning to green; switchback judgement decides reversion only, not effectiveness

roles_model.accountable_operator: single named operator per pilot (to be named at pilot approval; null until then)

ledger_tiers.near_miss: no harm caused but credible harm path revealed; pre-harm signals enter the ledger
ledger_tiers.decommission: permanently retired assets incl. dismantling method and data destruction

ledger_disciplines.write_back: every review-born design change must be written back into its scenario card
ledger_disciplines.auto_review_queue: model update / source withdrawal / authorization expiry -> dependent scenarios auto-enqueue for review; high-risk services degraded to human operation until cleared

evidence_status_enum.design_target: design target, not a government commitment

changes: top-level interop block added: conversion axis, status crosswalk table, known asymmetries, registered adjacent baselines, boundary
conversion axis named precisely: the external gate_id resolves to the local field `gate`, NOT to `ascent_grade` (attainment is not binding)
optional per-card interop object ({baseline, open_level_id}) accepted; absent from every card in this package by design
contract rule R5 added: a declared open_level_id must match a status/gate crosswalk row AND be backed by an ascent_grade of at least that level's bound grade
migration.crosswalk: All v0.2 fields are unchanged and every v0.2 file stays valid under v0.3. The interop block and the per-card interop object are both optional; a consumer that ignores them reads a v0.3 file exactly as it read v0.2. Adopters who declare an interop mapping thereby accept rule R5. Adopters keep their own sources, authorizations and field unknowns; template targets must never be presented as measured values or official commitments.

changes: file-level machine-readable license/attribution block added (CC-BY-4.0, protocol spec only)
green_candidate formally declared in status_enum as a pre-operational readiness state
cards with takeover_max_minutes=null now carry takeover_status (not_applicable | unknown)
anchors typed via anchor_type (geojson_ref | text_only) with anchor_ref for the former; anchor text retained unchanged for backward compatibility
previous_migration.crosswalk: All v0.1 fields are unchanged; new fields are additive. Consumers reading v0.1-era files should default a missing anchor_type to text_only, and treat takeover_max_minutes=null without takeover_status as unknown (conservative default). Adopters keep their own sources, authorizations and field unknowns; template targets must never be presented as measured values or official commitments.
